sectors.trend: Banks lead ASX higher but face structural headwinds: 15% drop in home loan applications, record house price fall forecasts (up to 10%), and CBA/Westpac loyalty-fee scrutiny
sectors.implications: Near-term earnings support from higher rates, but credit-loss provisions and NIM compression risk as housing cycle turns. CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX under pressure on volume growth

sectors.trend: Iron ore shakeout concealed by war-driven demand; Macarthur clears WA bulk test; Dalaroo expands African gold drilling; Lindian secures 20-yr rare earths offtake; Critical Resources finds NZ gold-antimony targets
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face medium-term iron ore oversupply risk. Small-caps (Dalaroo, Lindian, Critical Resources) offer exploration upside. Gold (GOLD.AX, NVL.AX) supported by geopolitical hedging

sectors.trend: TMK Energy gas rates surge on Mongolian drilling; Beetaloo urged to break gas cartel; OPEC+ holds output; oil prices rise on Iran tensions; jet fuel spike pressures airlines
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, BOQ.AX, SXG.AX benefit from gas price strength. QAN.AX faces margin pressure from fuel costs. Energy transition cost overruns (headline 56) weigh on renewables names

sectors.trend: Ozempic maker (Novo Nordisk) in trouble; tablet-based GLP-1 alternatives emerging as competitive threat
sectors.implications: CSL.AX relatively insulated but watch biotech supply-chain shifts. Local pharma and med-tech names may benefit from GLP-1 tablet pivot

sectors.trend: Australia braces for data centre boom; Vertiv acquires AI power provider; Nvidia confirms AI cycle intact; community opposition to data centres grows
sectors.implications: Infrastructure and power names (SGH.AX, AGL.AX) benefit. ASX-listed tech exposure limited but indirect via utilities and construction. Watch regulatory backlash risk

sectors.trend: Housing construction to follow prices lower; EV adoption carries hidden costs; McDonald's value menu squeezed; Melbourne councils admit infrastructure shortfall
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face rental pressure if housing supply glut emerges. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX) see margin pressure from input costs

key_themes: Housing cycle inflection: record price fall forecasts, 15% loan application drop, construction slowdown
RBA policy dilemma: fourth hike vs. stalling GDP and housing stress
Commodity bifurcation: iron ore oversupply vs. gold/silver geopolitical premium
Energy transition cost overruns and gas cartel dynamics
Corporate governance crisis: Bathla $3.4B collapse, KPMG/ASIC probe
AI/data centre infrastructure buildout in Australia
Geopolitical risk: Iran conflict reigniting, oil volatility

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA fourth rate hike amid housing downturn
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor RBA statement language; hedge via short-duration bonds and quality dividend equities

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing price correction (up to 10%) and construction collapse
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and construction exposure; favour defensive consumer staples

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Bathla-style corporate collapses / Ponzi economy contagion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Screen for high-leverage, related-party transaction exposure; favour balance-sheet strength

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical escalation (Iran war) driving oil/volatility spike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain gold and energy hedges; reduce beta exposure in volatile sessions

risk_assessment.risk_factor: KPMG/ASIC regulatory fallout and corporate governance erosion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid companies with weak audit trails; monitor ASIC enforcement actions

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Victoria sovereign debt warning from ratings agencies
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor state-guaranteed infrastructure and REIT exposures in VIC

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and precious metals on geopolitical hedging
opportunities.rationale: Iran conflict reigniting, silver falling on second-wave attacks creates entry point; structural demand intact

opportunities.recommendation: Selective energy exposure on gas price surge
opportunities.rationale: TMK rates surge, Beetaloo cartel-breaking potential, OPEC+ inaction supports oil

opportunities.recommendation: Small-cap rare earths and critical minerals exploration
opportunities.rationale: Lindian 20-yr offtake, Critical Resources NZ targets signal supply-chain diversification demand

opportunities.recommendation: Data centre infrastructure and power plays
opportunities.rationale: Australian data centre boom accelerating; Vertiv acquisition signals global capex cycle

defensive_moves.rationale: Record house price fall forecasts, 15% loan application drop, construction slowdown imminent

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim high-beta banks ahead of potential credit-loss provisioning
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing downturn will hit NPLs within 2-3 quarters; CBA already seeing volume decline

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash/gold buffer for geopolitical volatility
defensive_moves.rationale: Iran conflict reigniting, oil and bond yields elevated, crypto tumbling

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound with bank-led support offset by housing and rate-hike fears. Oil volatility from Iran tensions adds noise. Bathla fallout and KPMG probe create governance overhang. Expect 1-2% volatility around RBA commentary.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from housing correction and stalling GDP (vs Canada) cap upside. Iron ore shakeout and energy transition cost overruns pressure materials and energy. AI/data centre capex and critical minerals offer selective growth. 'Bull case returns' narrative (headline 22) needs GDP confirmation.
